//: Copy to fleet.json (gitignored) and edit. Every stream is PULLED over ssh from the machine running superlog-fleet: the servers need no agent, no open port, and no route to the hub, so the hub can stay loopback-bound.

hosts.//: A plain box: just its OS logs. `name` is the topic name - use a role, not the provider's hostname. os.<name>
hosts.name: web1

hosts.//: A busy box. `unit` scopes the OS stream to one service; apps come from the log-path catalog; docker follows container stdout.
hosts.name: api

hosts.//: A box with no ~/.ssh/config entry: an IP and a key is a complete answer.
hosts.name: notifier
